contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-payment-methods-pmd-registration-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-pmd-registration-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-pmd-registration.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/pmd-registration`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/pmd-registration says domain registration applies to payment methods including Link, Apple Pay and Google Pay in Elements or Checkout's embeddable form, and routes readers to Dashboard and API variants (new raw lines 5-14). It gives no registration steps or account or enabled-state rules. The 2026-05-08 guide covers domains and subdomains showing six listed methods, sandbox and live registration, Stripe web Apple Pay validation, and matching iframe origin with the Safari 17+ permission exception (old raw lines 8-27 and 50-61). For Connect, platforms act in connected-account context for direct charges and platform context for destination/separate charges (old raw lines 109-131). Disabling hides the payment methods on that domain and the domain can be enabled again. source-stripe-pmd-registration.md retains the historic procedures but compresses domain coverage and disable effects.
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/pmd-registration, November changes presentation and navigation by replacing the expanded May content with the Dashboard and API selector (new raw lines 9-14; old raw lines 29-37 and 63-65). No substantive removal or newly verified method or browser behavior follows. Preserve May's six-method scope, live registration before go-live and sandbox carryover, matching origin or Safari 17+ cross-origin permission, registration of both domains when different, and the Connect account context (old raw lines 8-27, 50-61, 81-105 and 109-131). Keep Web Apple Pay merchant validation separate from native setup. Preserve the detailed May raw and reciprocal Wallets route in source-stripe-pmd-registration.md alongside the November selector and existing Link and Checkout references.
